full: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Vaelora Siltmouths tidal tree, intact wood-harvest RTS sprite. Input 1 is the approved Siltmouths ecology reference, especially its exposed-root tidal tree. Input 2 defines our existing broad matte painterly RTS finish; do not copy its warm palette or maple species. Create one compact mature estuary tree, a stout nearly upright silver-grey trunk, arching exposed tidal roots with clear negative spaces, a broad grouped sea-green canopy with muted silver highlights and soft lilac shadows, a few restrained hanging tendrils. Keep trunk within about ten degrees of upright; naturally asymmetrical crown without dramatic leaning or twisted diagonal pose. Broad brush planes and foliage groups readable at game zoom. No blossoms, glowing magic, ornaments, animals, people, tools, ground, water, rocks, scenery, cast shadow, text or mist. Truly transparent background, including spaces between roots and branches. Orthographic target:45 degree azimuth,45.4359 degree elevation above ground,world Y up,zero camera roll. One complete tree, roots and canopy fully within a square canvas with transparent margins, lowest root contact near bottom center. Intended world bounds approximately 3.1 wide by 3.0 high. Subsequent harvest edits must preserve this logical canvas and ground registration.
